sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Hemant Sharma, learned counsel for applicants as well as Sri Sunil Kumar, learned Additional Government Advocate for State.
3.
The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Case Crime No.70 of 2013, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C., P.S. Anoopsahar, District Bulandshahar.

And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40953322/
1 4.

After arguing for some time, applicants' counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the applicants.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference U/s 438 Cr.P.C.

The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicants shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).

7. For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicants before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants- Chanchal Rawat and Priyanka Sharma, in the above case.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Ravi Kant (Krishan Pahal, J.)
